title: Trump Takes 2016 Election Suit Against Clinton to Supreme Court
detail: The Trump administration escalated its legal campaign against Hillary Clinton by petitioning the US Supreme Court over a 2016 election-related lawsuit. The move follows years of litigation stemming from Trump's claims about the 2016 election cycle and represents a significant escalation in the ongoing legal battles between the former adversaries.

media.caption: Trump escalates legal campaign against Clinton at Supreme Court

title: Trump Imposes Sanctions on ICC After Nobel Prize Awarded to Former Judge Navi Pillay
detail: The Trump administration imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court after the Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to former ICC judge Navi Pillay, who led the Gaza inquiry. The ICC called on member states to defend the institution, warning that history would judge the moment. The sanctions escalate US pressure on the international judicial body.
